where_to_find_data: Open publisher article via catalog URL; inspect Figure 1; check supplementary/author repository first
what_to_extract: Separate each ice-coverage series in Fig 1; record legend coverage and baseline; treat Fig 2 as simulated not experimental
critical_metadata: Temperature axis scale; normalize only after preserving raw intensity; convert Kelvin/Celsius explicitly
interpretation_and_quality_check: Check zero-order leading-edge overlap and common tail/edge; do not benchmark figure-2 simulation as experiment

where_to_find_data: Read paper and Table 1; check journal attachments; inspect Figures 1 and 2
what_to_extract: Trace water-ice coverages separately from Fig 1 and ammonia experimental curve(s) from Fig 2
critical_metadata: Coverage units and whether plotted curve is simulated; extract authors' order/E/nu with units
interpretation_and_quality_check: Compare reproduced profiles and reported order only if coverage convention agrees

where_to_find_data: Search DOI landing page for publisher PDF and supporting files; locate heating-rate/coverage panels (unverified)
what_to_extract: Separate every H2 trace by heating rate and exposure; record temperature of maxima
critical_metadata: Heating rate for EACH spectrum; report dosing treatment and substrate
interpretation_and_quality_check: Use peak-shift vs heating rate and order trends rather than uncalibrated prefactor

where_to_find_data: Read full article and inspect panels for alpha/beta H/Pd states; figure locations unverified
what_to_extract: Digitize alpha and beta features independently when resolvable; retain full overlapped trace
critical_metadata: Temperatures of each feature and treatment-dependent populations
interpretation_and_quality_check: Check whether Pd hydride formation invalidates simple single-state fitting

where_to_find_data: Use review bibliography to locate original experiments and their figure sources
what_to_extract: Only digitize a review figure after tracing primary-paper source and source permissions
critical_metadata: Primary provenance and whether figure is redraw of other work
interpretation_and_quality_check: Use mainly as theory reference until primary experimental traces located

where_to_find_data: Read foundational Redhead article; check existence of experimental plots (not confirmed)
what_to_extract: Prefer extract equations and reported model benchmarks rather than treating article as external experimental CSV
critical_metadata: Assumed desorption order, beta, temperature and prefactor
interpretation_and_quality_check: Use analytic/unit cross-checks; flag nonexperimental origin

where_to_find_data: Inspect references in review to identify original catalyst desorption datasets
what_to_extract: Link to primary experimental paper before digitizing spectra
critical_metadata: Support, pressure, mass transport and heating protocol
interpretation_and_quality_check: Caution that transport/readsorption can distort apparent kinetics

where_to_find_data: Find experimental coverage-series TPD diagrams in full article; figure not confirmed
what_to_extract: Digitize D2 signals and identify 170/200/220 K features separately if represented
critical_metadata: Coverage and surface preparation; peak assignment in text
interpretation_and_quality_check: Preserve overlapping spectra and uncertainties in deconvolution

where_to_find_data: Inspect Table A.2 and supplementary data download for numerical records
what_to_extract: Copy machine-readable published peak-temperature and beta pairs directly where permitted; cite table
critical_metadata: Species, substrate, beta units, original cited reference
interpretation_and_quality_check: Use as secondary metadata validation, not a fully digitized spectrum

where_to_find_data: Open article Fig 1 right panels; inspect additional electronic figure/supplement
what_to_extract: Digitize each SO2 coverage trace; flag artifact noted near 0.68 ML; keep Au vs water surfaces distinct
critical_metadata: ML, ice phase, temperature, artifact points
interpretation_and_quality_check: Test heterogeneous model limits and outlier handling

where_to_find_data: Retrieve original CO/Ir(110) publication; locate coverage dependence plots
what_to_extract: Trace selected coverages with known exposures; distinguish Redhead-style estimates from full traces
critical_metadata: CO coverage calibration and order assumptions
interpretation_and_quality_check: Do not interpret effective n as unique chemical elementary order

where_to_find_data: Open original ice-survey manuscript; inspect separate pure/layered/mixed-ice spectra
what_to_extract: Select pure-ice vs volcano/co-desorption curves; digitize panels independently
critical_metadata: Mixture recipe, ice thickness and heating rate
interpretation_and_quality_check: Complex ice trapping cannot be explained with only single-state PW

where_to_find_data: Locate CO submonolayer desorption panels; check supplementary numerical datasets
what_to_extract: Extract coverage series separately for each ice morphology
critical_metadata: Surface composition, thickness, doses, beta, relative signal
interpretation_and_quality_check: Compare effective parameters and residual structures; track heterogeneous populations

where_to_find_data: Inspect supplementary files before digitizing H2O:CO2 figures
what_to_extract: Separate CO2, CO and H2O channels per ramp and mixture
critical_metadata: Ice composition, heating rate, entrapment fraction
interpretation_and_quality_check: Use coupled process as intentionally out-of-model case

where_to_find_data: Inspect HCl/Pt(111) full text and its multi-peak plots; figure not verified
what_to_extract: Digitize raw intensity and independent component peak windows; preserve coverage labels
critical_metadata: Temperature, coverage/exposure, product channel
interpretation_and_quality_check: Do not force physically independent-order conclusions from mixed features

where_to_find_data: Inspect CO/Gd/Pt(111) TPD series on RSC landing page/PDF
what_to_extract: Digitize low/high coverage traces with consistent axis calibration
critical_metadata: Gd/Pt film conditions and coverage; beta
interpretation_and_quality_check: Evaluate whether fitted E varies systematically with coverage

where_to_find_data: Check whether traces are kinetic Monte Carlo predictions or external experimental sources
what_to_extract: Extract simulations only into separate theory-validation category
critical_metadata: Simulation assumptions and referenced experiments
interpretation_and_quality_check: Not independent experimental validation

where_to_find_data: Read article to determine whether TPD spectra actually appear or are cited
what_to_extract: If no original TPD trace, locate cited experimental H/graphite measurements
critical_metadata: Graphite treatment; dosing; temperature ramp
interpretation_and_quality_check: Do not claim experimental spectrum exists without full-text check

where_to_find_data: Identify any temperature-ramped spectra; article may instead present beam rate data
what_to_extract: Extract numeric kinetic constants rather than spectra if only isothermal data
critical_metadata: Rate units and temperature calibration
interpretation_and_quality_check: Not a confirmed TPD digitization candidate

where_to_find_data: Examine full TREELS paper for temperature-ramp plots
what_to_extract: If no TPD trace, only use numerical site/activation-energy reference
critical_metadata: Site assignment and measurement modality
interpretation_and_quality_check: Time-resolved EELS is not identical to TPD

where_to_find_data: Look for hydrogen/product TPD diagrams in publisher full text
what_to_extract: Digitize individual mass channels separately and retain Co/Pt preparation labels
critical_metadata: Surface composition, H exposure, monitored mass
interpretation_and_quality_check: Chemical reaction may produce peaks; flag distinctly

where_to_find_data: Open CO2/Ru(0001) main and supplementary figures
what_to_extract: Separate intact CO2 desorption from dissociation products
critical_metadata: Measured mass channel and CO2 dose
interpretation_and_quality_check: Not pure first-order desorption when dissociation is relevant

where_to_find_data: Locate comparative D2 spectra vs alloy composition in publisher PDF
what_to_extract: Digitize all alloy-composition traces at consistent coverage
critical_metadata: Ru/Pt composition, initial D amount, ramp
interpretation_and_quality_check: Different alloy kinetics may preclude shared kinetic constants

where_to_find_data: Inspect methanol isotope TPD mass channels from full publication
what_to_extract: Separate methanol parent and reaction product signals
critical_metadata: Isotopologue, detected m/z, coverage
interpretation_and_quality_check: Products are not independent simple desorption populations

where_to_find_data: Open article supporting information and Figure S1; verify plotted axes
what_to_extract: Digitize O2 TPD curves from S1 and label modified vs unmodified Ru
critical_metadata: 3 K/s ramp cited in catalog; O2 exposure and modification
interpretation_and_quality_check: Check whether signal is molecular oxygen vs recombination; permission check

where_to_find_data: Access newly published layered ice paper and supplementary files
what_to_extract: Extract layer-specific or irradiation-specific panels once identified
critical_metadata: Irradiation conditions and layer geometry; product channel
interpretation_and_quality_check: Treat as exploratory complexity challenge not order ground truth
